channel.title: Namibia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Namibia, every source cited.

item.title: Namibia secures N$940m for green hydrogen projects
item.description: The Green Climate Fund will channel US$56 million to support industrial decarbonisation and green ammonia production.

item.title: Namibia drills 12 boreholes in Oshikoto region
item.description: Six boreholes are fully installed to combat water scarcity affecting agricultural productivity and food security.

item.title: Cran appoints Doreen Zaaruka as human capital executive
item.description: Zaaruka brings extensive experience in human resources and organisational development to the communications regulator.

item.title: Bank of Namibia offers farmers 24-month loan relief
item.description: Agricultural borrowers affected by drought and disease can restructure debt and defer payments for up to two years.

item.title: Windhoek approves land for convention centre, hotel, stadium
item.description: The City Council also approved land for 104 residential plots in Cimbebasia Extension 10.
